# El Waha Pumps & Wells Services (شركة الواحة لخدمات الآبار والطلمبات)

> Egyptian supplier, installer and maintainer of deep-well pumping equipment since 2013.
> Exclusive Egyptian agent for 12 manufacturers: Kurlar, Panelli, Astral Pipes, PMC, NOVO,
> Tormac, Üntel, Alka, Voltson, Rovatti, Franklin Electric, Aristoncavi.
> Head office: CPC Industrial Complex, 6th Industrial Zone, 6th of October City, Giza, Egypt.
> Sales: +20 106 668 5532 (WhatsApp: https://wa.me/201066685532) · info@elwahapumps.com.
> Prices are quoted on request; there is no online payment. Arabic site: /ar, English: /en.

## Tools

- [Pump selector](https://elwahapumps.com/en/selector): ranks pumps by efficiency at a
  requested duty point. GET with query parameters `q` (flow), `qu` (flow unit: m3h, ls,
  or lmin), `h` (head), `hu` (head unit: m or bar) — e.g.
  `/en/selector?q=60&qu=m3h&h=120&hu=m`.

## Machine-readable data

- [Full catalogue text dump](https://elwahapumps.com/llms-full.txt): every product,
  category and spec, regenerated on every deploy.
- [Product feed](https://elwahapumps.com/api/products): JSON, bilingual names and specs,
  no prices — quoted on request. Single product: `/api/products/{slug}`.
- [Pump selector API](https://elwahapumps.com/api/selector?q=60&qu=m3h&h=120&hu=m): JSON
  equivalent of the selector page above, same query parameters.
